index.chunk: tree-sitter declarations instead of fixed-size windows, because windows cut functions and duplicate context. Cost: only Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, Java and C/C++ have grammars, and code outside declarations, such as imports, is not indexed.
index.embed: A local INT8 ONNX model on the CPU instead of a hosted embedding API, so code never leaves the machine. Cost: a one-time 137 MB download, and the model loads on every command, so queries take 0.9 to 1.8 s.
disk.vectors: An append-only log with tombstones plus a hand-written HNSW graph instead of a database, so updates never rewrite the file. Cost: the whole log is read into memory per query, and the graph is rebuilt on each changed index run.
fuse: Reciprocal Rank Fusion instead of adding raw scores, because cosine similarity and BM25 sit on incompatible scales. Cost: only ranks are used, so a far stronger match gets no more weight than a marginally stronger one.
